## Marian Stancik

Marian Stancik builds autonomous AI agent ecosystems (Hermes Agent, MCP), hardware engineering (hand-built UAV with Raspberry Pi 5 edge AI), and regulatory-aware architectures (EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA).

- [Expertise](https://www.marianstancik.dev/expertise): Detailed spec matrices across primary skill: Autonomous AI Agents.

- [Contact](https://www.marianstancik.dev/contact): Let's build your AI agent.
- [Drones](https://www.marianstancik.dev/drones): Hobby project — hand-built 1500g carbon UAV with ArduPilot + RPi5 edge AI.
